Chapter 2: Cube Root of Logarithmic Function | Page 33

Home Work 21
Problem Statement Triple Composite Chain Rule
Find the derivative with respect to xxx of the function:
y=log⁡(sin⁡x)3y = \sqrt[3]{\log(\sin x)}y=3log(sinx)​
STEP 1 প্রদত্ত ঘনমূলীয় ফাংশনটিকে সূচকীয় আকারে প্রকাশ করি (Expressing in Power Form)
y=[log⁡(sin⁡x)]1/3y = \left[\log(\sin x)\right]^{1/3}y=[log(sinx)]1/3
STEP 2 উভয়পক্ষে xxx-এর সাপেক্ষে অন্তরীকরণ অপারেটর প্রয়োগ করি (Applying Differentiation Operator w.r.t. x)
dydx=ddx([log⁡(sin⁡x)]1/3)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{d}{dx}\left( \left[\log(\sin x)\right]^{1/3} \right)dxdy​=dxd​([log(sinx)]1/3)
STEP 3 বাহ্যিক সূচকের জন্য শক্তি বিধি (Power Rule) প্রয়োগ করি (Applying Power Rule to Outer Power)
dydx=13[log⁡(sin⁡x)]13−1⋅ddx[log⁡(sin⁡x)]=13[log⁡(sin⁡x)]−2/3⋅ddx[log⁡(sin⁡x)]\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{3}\left[\log(\sin x)\right]^{\frac{1}{3} - 1} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}\left[\log(\sin x)\right] = \frac{1}{3}\left[\log(\sin x)\right]^{-2/3} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}\left[\log(\sin x)\right]dxdy​=31​[log(sinx)]31​−1⋅dxd​[log(sinx)]=31​[log(sinx)]−2/3⋅dxd​[log(sinx)]
STEP 4 অভ্যন্তরীণ লগারিদমীয় ত্রিকোণমিতিক অংশের অন্তরজ নির্ণয় করি (Differentiating Inner Function via Chain Rule)
ddx[log⁡(sin⁡x)]=1sin⁡x⋅ddx(sin⁡x)=1sin⁡x⋅cos⁡x=cot⁡x\frac{d}{dx}\left[\log(\sin x)\right] = \frac{1}{\sin x} \cdot \frac{d}{dx}(\sin x) = \frac{1}{\sin x} \cdot \cos x = \cot xdxd​[log(sinx)]=sinx1​⋅dxd​(sinx)=sinx1​⋅cosx=cotx
STEP 5 মানগুলি একত্রিত করে চূড়ান্ত অন্তরজ পাই (Combining Factors into Final Form)
dydx=13[log⁡(sin⁡x)]2/3⋅cot⁡x=cot⁡x3[log⁡(sin⁡x)]2/3\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{1}{3\left[\log(\sin x)\right]^{2/3}} \cdot \cot x = \frac{\cot x}{3\left[\log(\sin x)\right]^{2/3}}dxdy​=3[log(sinx)]2/31​⋅cotx=3[log(sinx)]2/3cotx​
FINAL ANSWER dydx=cot⁡x3[log⁡(sin⁡x)]2/3(or, cot⁡x3log⁡2(sin⁡x)3)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{\cot x}{3\left[\log(\sin x)\right]^{2/3}} \quad \left(\text{or, } \frac{\cot x}{3\sqrt[3]{\log^2(\sin x)}}\right)dxdy​=3[log(sinx)]2/3cotx​​or, 33log2(sinx)​cotx​​

📘 Box 1: Mathematical Foundations & Formula Reference
  • Composite Hierarchy: The function has 3 layers: y=u1/3y = u^{1/3}y=u1/3 where u=log⁡vu = \log vu=logv and v=sin⁡xv = \sin xv=sinx. dydx=dydu⋅dudv⋅dvdx=(13u−2/3)⋅(1v)⋅(cos⁡x)\frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{dy}{du} \cdot \frac{du}{dv} \cdot \frac{dv}{dx} = \left(\frac{1}{3}u^{-2/3}\right) \cdot \left(\frac{1}{v}\right) \cdot (\cos x)dxdy​=dudy​⋅dvdu​⋅dxdv​=(31​u−2/3)⋅(v1​)⋅(cosx)
  • Standard Trigonometric Ratio: cos⁡xsin⁡x=cot⁡x\frac{\cos x}{\sin x} = \cot xsinxcosx​=cotx.
  • Power Rule with Fractional Exponent: ddx[u1/3]=13u−2/3dudx\frac{d}{dx}[u^{1/3}] = \frac{1}{3}u^{-2/3}\frac{du}{dx}dxd​[u1/3]=31​u−2/3dxdu​.
⚠️ Box 2: Common Student Traps & Pitfalls
  • Exponent Misinterpretation: Confusing log⁡(sin⁡x)3=[log⁡(sin⁡x)]1/3\sqrt[3]{\log(\sin x)} = [\log(\sin x)]^{1/3}3log(sinx)​=[log(sinx)]1/3 with log⁡(sin⁡1/3x)=13log⁡(sin⁡x)\log(\sin^{1/3} x) = \frac{1}{3}\log(\sin x)log(sin1/3x)=31​log(sinx). The cube root applies to the entire logarithm, not the argument!
  • Exponent Subtraction Error: 13−1=−23\frac{1}{3} - 1 = -\frac{2}{3}31​−1=−32​. Writing 23\frac{2}{3}32​ without negative sign creates incorrect numerator placement.
  • Missing Inner Derivative: Forgetting to differentiate sin⁡x\sin xsinx to cos⁡x\cos xcosx, erroneously writing 1sin⁡x\frac{1}{\sin x}sinx1​ alone.
🌐 Box 3: Real Domain & Differentiability Analysis
  • Logarithmic Constraint: sin⁡x>0  ⟹  x∈(2kπ,(2k+1)π)\sin x > 0 \implies x \in (2k\pi, (2k+1)\pi)sinx>0⟹x∈(2kπ,(2k+1)π) for k∈Zk \in \mathbb{Z}k∈Z.
  • Denominator Singularity in Derivative: log⁡(sin⁡x)≠0  ⟹  sin⁡x≠1  ⟹  x≠2kπ+π2\log(\sin x) \neq 0 \implies \sin x \neq 1 \implies x \neq 2k\pi + \frac{\pi}{2}log(sinx)=0⟹sinx=1⟹x=2kπ+2π​. At sin⁡x=1\sin x = 1sinx=1, the tangent line becomes vertical (dydx→∞\frac{dy}{dx} \to \inftydxdy​→∞).
  • Differentiability: Smooth and differentiable on (2kπ,2kπ+π2)∪(2kπ+π2,(2k+1)π)(2k\pi, 2k\pi + \frac{\pi}{2}) \cup (2k\pi + \frac{\pi}{2}, (2k+1)\pi)(2kπ,2kπ+2π​)∪(2kπ+2π​,(2k+1)π).
